title: Qwen3.5 9B on Hugging Face
evidence: Measured on Hugging Face 28 Oct 2026 (C1), seeded data: 90 rows, 69 steps on a100-large (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB): 1,954 s billed (33 min, $1.38); peak 19.8 GB of 80 GB; validation loss per pass 0.653, 0.639, 0.661 (finite); 3 passes exported to Q8_0 GGUF in the job (474 s); downloaded, checked and served here in Row-Bot's own server (probe and a real tool turn). The L40S alternative is an estimate (1.5x the A100's time a step), not measured.
